title: On the Generalized Arithmetic Picard--Lefschetz Formula
summary: This dissertation establishes an explicit arithmetic Picard--Lefschetz formula for isolated singularities of diagonal type. We investigate proper and flat families of varieties defined over a henselian discrete valuation ring of mixed characteristic. When the smooth generic fiber degenerates into a special fiber with isolated diagonal singularities, we construct an explicit eigenbasis for the tame inertia action on the local vanishing cycles.
